Counts are indexed records, not distinct ideas or papers. Absence of a record is a gap in the atlas, not evidence that nothing exists.

text: The judge has two different modes. In (a) discriminative mode, the judge decides whether the correct solution can be obtained after all the debaters finish their arguments in the current iteration; if so, the debate is over, otherwise it continues.
title: MAD judge: discriminative mode decides whether the debate ends
